author: How It Should Have Ended
description:
Every Star Wars HISHE episode in one Giant Supercut!  Every animated alternate ending cartoon we've made from episode 1 all the way to 9 and beyond.  A collection over two decades of how Star Wars Should Have Ended.

If you want to support this channel consider signing up to our patreon!
